values.note: Operator's rates page, read 2026-10-21: full hookup $50 daily, $300 weekly, $550 monthly plus electric (3-month minimum for the winter monthly rate); tent (no electric) $40. Plus state and county sales and tourist tax; rates for 2 people, one car, one unit. Daily reservations are paid in full up front; cancel 30+ days ahead for a full refund, by mail or phone only.

sites.source: https://www.astorlanding.com/campground.html ('Pull Thru Sites', 'Level Sites (50 feet deep)'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.astorlanding.com/campground.html ('Bath House With Hot Showers', 'Sewer Dump Station', 'Laundry Room'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations by phone, paid at booking; no online booking. Stays under 15 nights may be booked two months ahead, longer stays three months ahead. No refunds for holiday weekends or special events. Checkout noon.

booking.source: https://www.astorlanding.com/rates.html ('Reservations for less than fifteen (15) nights may be made two (2) months before a planned stay', deposit and cancellation policy), read 2026-10-21

note: On the St. Johns River in Astor, surrounded by Ocala National Forest. Level sites 50 ft deep. Daily/weekly/monthly. Marina with boat ramp, wet slips, storage; fishing. RV sites ring an interior pond (the advertised "waterfront camping"), set back from the St. Johns River behind the marina + treeline; not river-frontage. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms $50 full hookup, 30/50 A, water+sewer, pull-through, laundry; added showers, dump station, phone booking with a two-month window. Not stated: site count, max rig length ('50 feet deep' sites; derived 50 ft left), season.
flags: Price gate: base $50/night (full hookup) exactly, at not over US$50; rates page carries no date (read 2026-10-21).
